up: Retrieve activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1944495 (Proteasome subunit beta type-9) where the activity is an IC50 measurement with an exact standard value ('=' relation) and a non‑null pChEMBL value. Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Include only rows where the target organism is Homo sapiens. Order the result set by molecule ChEMBL ID (ascending) and assay ChEMBL ID (ascending). Return the first 1000 rows of the ordered list.
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1944495'), assay AS (SELECT a.assay_id, a.tid, a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.tid, td.target_type, td.tax_id FROM assays a JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid WHERE a.tid = (SELECT tid FROM target), activity AS (SELECT a.activity_id, a.assay_id, a.molecule_chembl_id, a.pchembl_value, a.standard_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id WHERE td.tid = (SELECT tid FROM target) AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND td.tax_id = 9606) SELECT assay.assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM assay JOIN target_dictionary td ON assay.tid = td.tid JOIN activity a ON assay.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id ORDER BY a.molecule_chembl_id, assay.assay_chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
